## Evidence classification

Every significant claim must carry one of:

- [ ] `VERIFIED`
- [ ] `DOCUMENTED_NOT_HARDWARE_VERIFIED`
- [ ] `PLAUSIBLE_REQUIRES_TESTING`
- [ ] `UNKNOWN`
- [ ] `REQUIRES_SCHOOL_PERMISSION`
- [ ] `REQUIRES_MANUFACTURER_OR_SERVICE_PROVIDER`
- [ ] `NOT_RECOMMENDED_OR_NOT_PERMITTED_WITHOUT_APPROVAL`

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, keys, tokens, CCTV details, or private network information
- [ ] No student or staff personal data
- [ ] No floor plans or layouts not approved for circulation
- [ ] No capability described as operational without evidence
- [ ] Sources cited with title, URL, date accessed, and limitation
- [ ] Questionnaire changes keep stable question IDs
- [ ] Decision changes include a reversal condition
- [ ] Contradictions between sources are documented, not silently resolved
